title: A superconvergent hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin method for the convective Cahn--Hilliard equation
summary: We propose a hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin (HDG) method combined with convex-concave splitting for the temporal discretization of the convective Cahn-Hilliard equation. The convection term is discretized explicitly without stabilization, yielding three key advantages: (1) unconditional stability, (2) preservation of the optimal convergence rate for piecewise constant approximations, and (3) a symmetric system after local elimination, enabling efficient solver via minimal residual methods. We establish optimal convergence rates in the $L^2$ norm for both the scalar and flux variables…
